title: fzf — Fuzzy Finder
description: Supercharge your terminal with fuzzy finding — files, history, processes, git branches, and more.

entries.label: Find Files
entries.description: Interactively fuzzy-search files in the current directory tree

entries.label: Search History
entries.description: Fuzzy search your shell command history (replaces default reverse search)

entries.label: Change Directory
entries.description: Fuzzy find and cd into a subdirectory

entries.label: Open File in Editor
entries.description: Find a file with fzf and open it directly in your editor

entries.label: Preview Files
entries.description: Show file contents preview while browsing (requires bat)

entries.label: Search File Contents
entries.description: Search text across all files with live preview of matches

entries.label: Git Branch Switcher
entries.command: git branch | fzf | xargs git checkout
entries.description: Fuzzy select and checkout a git branch

entries.label: Kill Process
entries.command: ps aux | fzf | awk '{print $2}' | xargs kill -9
entries.description: Interactively find and kill a process

entries.label: Docker Container Shell
entries.command: docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | fzf | xargs -I{} docker exec -it {} sh
entries.description: Fuzzy select a running container and exec into it

entries.label: Multi-Select
entries.description: Select multiple items with Tab, then pipe to a command
